{collection}.{field}: personal to {collection}.{person}, which is itself personal.
The link that names the person must stay readable, so the SDK can find the person's key.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses a model that breaks a rule on its own: a personal field's person is a link field that is itself personal. Opening with such a lock shows it after error.lockInvalid's colon.
